# Vendored admin assets

`adminlte-v4/` is the AdminLTE v4.10.1 static asset bundle used by the admin panel. It is served locally, so the admin area does not need a build step or CDN access.

Included:

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `adminlte-v4/css/adminlte.css` | AdminLTE 4 + Bootstrap 5.3 CSS |
| `adminlte-v4/css/source-sans-3.css` | Source Sans 3 webfont faces |
| `adminlte-v4/css/bootstrap-icons.min.css` | Bootstrap Icons + fonts |
| `adminlte-v4/css/overlayscrollbars.min.css` | OverlayScrollbars styles |
| `adminlte-v4/js/adminlte.js` | AdminLTE layout plugins |
| `adminlte-v4/js/bootstrap.min.js` | Bootstrap 5 JS |
| `adminlte-v4/js/popper.min.js` | Popper (Bootstrap dependency) |
| `adminlte-v4/js/overlayscrollbars.browser.es6.min.js` | OverlayScrollbars runtime |

License: MIT (AdminLTE, Bootstrap, Bootstrap Icons, OverlayScrollbars).
